title: Origins and History
description: Origins and History. Cricket was played in England by the 1500s, grew through village and county matches, and took its first written Laws in 1744 The Marylebone Cricket Club, founded in 1787, became the keeper of the Laws, and the game spread through the British world in the 1800s Early cricket used underarm bowling on rough fields, and overarm bowling, pads, and gloves arrived as the game modernized In practice, Read one era of the game's history per week, then watch highlights from that era to see the change.

demo.code:
# Cricket: Origins and History - avg calculator
A = 1744
B = 1787
print('Values: %s and %s' % (A, B))
print('Average: %.2f' % ((A + B) / 2.0))
print('Total: %s' % (A + B))

history: Cricket was played in England by the 1500s, grew through village and county matches, and took its first written Laws in 1744
rules: The Marylebone Cricket Club, founded in 1787, became the keeper of the Laws, and the game spread through the British world in the 1800s
techniques: Early cricket used underarm bowling on rough fields, and overarm bowling, pads, and gloves arrived as the game modernized
training: Read one era of the game's history per week, then watch highlights from that era to see the change

title: Laws and Formats
description: Laws and Formats. The Laws of Cricket govern the pitch, the wickets, dismissals, and fair play, and three main formats now share the game A Test match lasts up to five days with two innings a side, a one-day match is 50 overs a side, and a Twenty20 match is 20 overs a side Captains balance attack and defense across formats, since a patient Test innings and a fast Twenty20 innings demand different risks In practice, Learn one Law per session, then spot it in a live match before moving to the next.

demo.code:
# Cricket: Laws and Formats - pct calculator
A = 50
B = 20
print('Made: %s of %s attempts' % (A, B))
print('Success rate: %.1f%%' % (100.0 * A / B))
print('Missed: %s' % (B - A))
demo.expected_output:
Made: 50 of 20 attempts
Success rate: 250.0%
Missed: -30

title: Batting
description: Batting. Batting has always been the game's glamour skill, from early straight bats to the modern range of attacking strokes A batter defends the wicket, scores runs by hitting the ball and running or reaching the boundary, and is out when bowled, caught, leg-before, run out, or stumped Grip, stance, backlift, and head position build a repeatable method, and shot selection follows the line and length of each ball In practice, Face throwdowns in the nets daily, starting with straight defense and adding one attacking shot at a time.

demo.code:
# Cricket: Batting - total calculator
A = 6
B = 4
print('Sessions per week: %s, weeks: %s' % (A, B))
print('Total sessions: %s' % (A * B))
print('Sessions in half the block: %s' % (A * B // 2))
demo.expected_output:
Sessions per week: 6, weeks: 4
Total sessions: 24
Sessions in half the block: 12

history: Batting has always been the game's glamour skill, from early straight bats to the modern range of attacking strokes
rules: A batter defends the wicket, scores runs by hitting the ball and running or reaching the boundary, and is out when bowled, caught, leg-before, run out, or stumped
techniques: Grip, stance, backlift, and head position build a repeatable method, and shot selection follows the line and length of each ball
training: Face throwdowns in the nets daily, starting with straight defense and adding one attacking shot at a time

title: Pace Bowling
description: Pace Bowling. Fast bowling became a spectacle as overarm bowling and harder pitches let bowlers attack with speed and bounce A pace bowler runs in and delivers the ball to bounce once before the batter, aiming to beat the bat with pace, seam, or swing Seam position, wrist position, and a strong front arm produce swing and seam movement, while bouncers and yorkers vary length In practice, Build a repeatable run-up first, then add one variation at a time in net sessions.

demo.code:
# Cricket: Pace Bowling - span calculator
A = 22
B = 6
print('Earlier year: %s, later year: %s' % (A, B))
print('Span: %s years' % (B - A))
print('Midpoint year: %s' % ((A + B) // 2))
demo.expected_output:
Earlier year: 22, later year: 6
Span: -16 years
Midpoint year: 14

history: Fast bowling became a spectacle as overarm bowling and harder pitches let bowlers attack with speed and bounce
rules: A pace bowler runs in and delivers the ball to bounce once before the batter, aiming to beat the bat with pace, seam, or swing
techniques: Seam position, wrist position, and a strong front arm produce swing and seam movement, while bouncers and yorkers vary length

title: Spin Bowling
description: Spin Bowling. Spin bowling grew as a slower, turning art that outwits batters with flight, dip, and turn off the pitch A spinner delivers slowly, grips the ball across or along the seam, and turns it away from or into the batter after bouncing Off-spin turns into the right-handed batter, leg-spin turns away, and flight tempts the batter to attack and miss In practice, Bowl long spells at a single stump in practice, varying flight before varying line.

demo.code:
# Cricket: Spin Bowling - pace calculator
A = 6
B = 2
print('Distance: %s units, sessions: %s' % (A, B))
print('Pace per session: %.2f units' % (A / float(B)))
print('Double the block: %.1f units' % (A * 2.0))
demo.expected_output:
Distance: 6 units, sessions: 2
Pace per session: 3.00 units
Double the block: 12.0 units

history: Spin bowling grew as a slower, turning art that outwits batters with flight, dip, and turn off the pitch
rules: A spinner delivers slowly, grips the ball across or along the seam, and turns it away from or into the batter after bouncing
techniques: Off-spin turns into the right-handed batter, leg-spin turns away, and flight tempts the batter to attack and miss
training: Bowl long spells at a single stump in practice, varying flight before varying line

title: Fielding
description: Fielding. Fielding was long the game's neglected skill, and modern limited-overs cricket made athletic fielding a match-winning art Fielders stop runs, catch batters out, and run batters out, with close catchers behind the bat and outfielders patrolling the boundary Ground fielding uses a low, side-on pickup, throwing uses a strong crow-hop, and slip catching needs soft hands and still feet In practice, Field in pairs daily, mixing ground balls, high catches, and throwing at a stump.

title: Wicketkeeping

Share of A: 85.7%
